name: Bomber
# Like the Stalker, but bombs at range instead of poisoning by touch.
# Found an enemy (top row): bomb it (fails quietly if out of range), step toward it.
# Nothing in sight (bottom row): keep wandering; turn right when blocked.

name: Roamer
# A gatherer with a memory: the wander direction lives at the bottom of the stack.
# Found a resource (top row): head toward it, and adopt that as the wander direction.
# Nothing in sight (bottom row): keep going the same way; turn right when blocked.
